title: Comparison of the effects of chemical surfactant and bio-surfactant on montmorillonite colloid-mediated transport of levofloxacin through saturated porous media
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00127G, Paper
Bin Wang, Zhiwei Chen, Kunyu Wen, Qiang Zhang, Taotao Lu, Usman Farooq, Zhichong Qi
The transport behavior of levofloxacin (LEV, a typical fluoroquinolone antibiotic) in aquifers may be affected by clay particles (e.g., montmorillonite colloids) and surfactants, which are widespread in aquatic environments.
